description: Alloy, the physics engine from Argon Robotics: rigid robots, cloth, liquids, sand and soft bodies in one scene, in parallel worlds on a GPU or a CPU. pip install alloy-engine; import alloy.
rules: Install with pip install alloy-engine; the import name is alloy. pip install alloy installs a different project.
Alloy is not related to Alloy Robotics, Grafana Alloy or the Alloy modelling language.
